images.prompt: A dimly lit studio close-up of an anonymous doctor figure in a white coat, face obscured by soft shadow and shallow depth of field, seated facing the camera; empty blank caption bars stack one by one along the lower frame, no lettering, moody low-key lighting, cinematic teal-gray tone.

Medium shot of a faceless doctor silhouette in a white coat against a clean dark studio backdrop, calm reassuring open-palm gesture; a soft glowing rectangular banner with no text floats at chest level, subtle logo-free light bloom transition, professional medical channel look.

Anonymous doctor figure facing camera on the left, three clean floating UI cards on the right showing only simple icons (a stopwatch, an ear, a moon), all blank of text; a faint half-transparent line-graph panel flashes in the background, modern medical infographic style.

Black background with a glowing white cracking-glass graphic shaped like an ear symbol splitting apart, fracture lines radiating outward, no lettering; behind it a dim anonymous doctor silhouette gradually emerging, dramatic conceptual illustration.

Clean educational illustration of an unlabeled audiogram-style line chart dissolving into a stylized auditory pathway animation: cochlea to auditory nerve to brain, glowing signal flow; a small amplifier-switch icon lights up near the neck region, no text, teal and white medical vector style.

Educational anatomy illustration close-up of the four paired suboccipital muscles at the skull base, transitioning to the sternocleidomastoid overlapping the carotid vessel path, then a highlighted styloid process marker; inset live-action shot of anonymous hands pressing the back of one's own neck, no text.

Four clean floating classification cards arranged in sequence on a dark background, each showing a single simple icon only — a neck, an ear, a pulse wave, a jaw joint — no text anywhere, soft glowing edges, minimal medical UI design.

Three close-up live-action inserts of anonymous hands demonstrating self-palpation: fingertips at the suboccipital skull base, along the side neck muscle, and at the jaw joint; a small blank circular timer ring glows in the upper right corner, warm clean studio lighting, no text.

Fast montage collage of three previous concept frames — cervical spine, auditory pathway, autonomic seesaw — flashing in rapid motion-blurred sequence, then the screen fills with a bold empty caption band and dramatic light flare, no lettering.

Three sequential red X warning cards on a dark background, each with a single icon: earbuds with loud sound waves, a neck twisting motion arrow, a smartphone with a search magnifier; small inset live-action reenactments with anonymous cropped figures, textless design.

Split two-angle demonstration of an anonymous doctor figure in a white coat, front and side view, showing gentle self-massage of the suboccipital and side neck muscles; extreme close-up of finger placement and a rolled towel alternative, clean studio, no text or numbers.

Recreated dark bedroom set with warm dim lamp light, an anonymous seated figure in relaxed upright posture demonstrating slow breathing; a glowing circular breathing gauge expands and contracts beside them, no numerals or text, calm cinematic mood.

Clean split-screen desk setup comparison: left side a slumped anonymous silhouette with a low monitor and forward jaw, right side an upright silhouette with the monitor raised to eye level; a simple horizontal eye-level guideline glows across both halves, no text.

Silent-mode clinical evidence montage on a neutral background: a blurred generic journal cover mockup with no readable text, followed by a simple two-bar chart showing a tall bar dropping to a tiny bar, then three unlabeled pure-tone audiogram line charts in sequence, clean minimal data-visualization style.

Five sequential emergency warning cards on a deep red background, each carrying only a bold white pictogram — sudden hearing loss ear, spinning vertigo arrows, pulsing vessel, one-sided ear, drooping face outline — no lettering, urgent high-contrast design.

A four-line stack of blank glowing summary bars on dark background, then a three-second macro close-up of a slim sterile acupotomy needle-knife instrument resting on clean cloth, then an anonymous doctor figure facing camera with a calm cautionary gesture, no text.

Medium shot of an anonymous doctor silhouette facing the camera in a clean studio, with a floating subscribe bell icon and a speech-bubble comment icon beside them, ending on a full-screen soft gray disclaimer panel with no readable lettering, minimal professional finish.
